files.note: scan_skill obeys a .skillignore or .clawhubignore that the skill ships itself, and leaves the paths it lists out of both the structure check and the pattern scan, so a bundle can hide its own payload (scripts/ with curl | bash, an .exe) and scan as safe (checked 27 October 2026 at 1ae3c55e; Hermes' own installer strips neither file). Whoever installs skills from outside must delete every .skillignore and .clawhubignore in the quarantined bundle before calling scan_skill, or refuse a bundle that has one. It also misses the ClawHavoc lure written as prose only.

(agent/tool_dispatch_helpers.py).
